CQFM Direct Reference Code: inpatient acute (Details: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode code ACUTE = 'inpatient acute', stated as 'inpatient acute')

value: Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period

value: define "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period": ( [Encounter: "Encounter Inpatient"] union [Encounter: "Emergency Department Visit"] union [Encounter: "Observation Services"] union [Encounter: class in {"emergency", "inpatient acute", "inpatient encounter", "inpatient non-acute", "short stay"}]) QualifyingEncounters where QualifyingEncounters .status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged'} and QualifyingEncounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period"
value: Qualifying Location During Measurement Period

value: /*((end of QualifyingEncounters.period is not null and QualifyingEncounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period") or (QualifyingEncounters.period starts before "Measurement Period" or QualifyingEncounters.period starts during "Measurement Period"))*/ define "Qualifying Location During Measurement Period": "Encounters" Encounters where exists( Encounters.location EncounterLocation where Global.GetLocation(EncounterLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations" and EncounterLocation.period overlaps Encounters.period )
value: define "Initial Population": "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period" union "Qualifying Location During Measurement Period"

value: define "SDE Encounter": "Encounters" Encounters where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.EncounterResource(Encounters, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-encounter'}})

value: define "SDE Medication Request": [MedicationRequest] MedicationRequests where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.MedicationRequestResource(MedicationRequests, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-medicationrequest'}})

value: define "SDE Coverage": [Coverage] Coverages where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.CoverageResource(Coverages, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/coverage'}})

value: define "SDE Procedure": [Procedure] Procedures where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ProcedureResource(Procedures, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-procedure'}})

value: define "SDE Device": [Device] Devices where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.DeviceResource(Devices, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/device'}})

value: define "SDE Medication Administration": [MedicationAdministration] MedicationAdministrations where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.MedicationAdministrationResource(MedicationAdministrations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/medicationadministration'}})

value: define "SDE Observation Category": [Observation] Observations where ((exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "laboratory")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "social-history")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "vital-signs")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "survey")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "imaging")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "procedure"))) and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ObservationResource(Observations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-observation-lab'}})

value: define "SDE Initial Population Encounters": "Initial Population" IP return SharedResource.EncounterResource(IP, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-encounter'}})

value: //============================ //Supplemental Data Element //============================ define "SDE Condition": [Condition] Conditions where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ConditionResource(Conditions, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-condition'}})

value: define "SDE Location": [Location] Locations where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.LocationResource(Locations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-location'}})

value: define "SDE DiagnosticReport": [DiagnosticReport] DiagnosticReports where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.DiagnosticReportResource(DiagnosticReports, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-diagnosticreport-lab'}})
value: define "SDE Minimal Patient": Patient p return SharedResource.PatientResource(p, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://www.cdc.gov/nhsn/fhirportal/dqm/ig/StructureDefinition/cross-measure-patient'}})

value: define "SDE Medication": [Medication] Medication where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.MedicationResource(Medication, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-medication'}})

value: define "SDE Specimen": [Specimen] Specimen where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.SpecimenResource(Specimen, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/specimen'}})
